data.title: Elite Business Bay Residence
data.about:
Elite Business Bay, a prestigious development by one of Dubai's top real estate developers, introduces the luxurious Elite Business Bay Residence. This magnificent 24-story residential tower, strategically located in the vibrant Business Bay area, near the picturesque Dubai Water Canal, offers unrivaled views of the iconic Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall, the mesmerizing Dubai Fountain, and the spectacular Downtown Dubai skyline, making it one of Dubai's most sought-after addresses.

The Elite Business Bay Residence is not just a place to live; it's a lifestyle choice for those seeking elegance and convenience in the heart of Dubai. Offering a range of fully furnished living spaces from cozy studios to spacious 1, 2, and 4-bedroom apartments, with sizes ranging from 410 sq. ft. to an expansive 2,200 sq. ft., Elite Business Bay caters to diverse preferences and lifestyles. Each home within the Elite Tower Business Bay has been meticulously crafted by a team of expert designers, ensuring that every detail contributes to the luxurious lifestyle envisioned by its residents.

For a closer look at what life is like in this prestigious development, Elite Business Bay Residence photos showcase the sophistication and attention to detail that are hallmarks of the Elite Business Bay offerings. Potential residents interested in Elite Business Bay Residence rent options will find themselves spoilt for choice, with a variety of configurations and sizes available to suit every need.

characteristics_module.title: Discover Elite Living at Elite Business Bay Residence
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Iconic Architecture: Discover the 24-story Elite Tower in Business Bay, showcasing stunning aesthetics, a contemporary concept, and a practical design. Ideal for those seeking an Elite Business Bay residence.
  • Exclusive Living Spaces: Choose from fully furnished studio, 1, 2, and 4 bedroom freehold apartments at Elite Residence Business Bay, each offering breathtaking views of Burj Khalifa and the lake.
  • Gourmet Kitchens: Each apartment features a fully equipped kitchen with top-tier appliances, making every Elite Business Bay Residence meal a culinary adventure.
  • Luxury Bathrooms: Indulge in opulence with master bathrooms in 2 and 4 bedroom apartments, including a Jacuzzi, and all bathrooms boasting high-quality sanitary ware and faucets from the renowned American brand Kohler at Elite Tower Business Bay.
  • Leisure and Wellness: Elite Business Bay offers separate swimming pools for adults and children, a health club, steam and sauna rooms, ensuring a balanced lifestyle.
  • Convenience and Security: Benefit from covered car parking, 24-hour efficient security services, and a location close to schools, shopping areas, and recreational facilities at Elite Residence Business Bay.

location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Located in the bustling heart of Dubai, Elite Business Bay is a hallmark of luxury and convenience, offering its residents unparalleled access to the city's most prestigious landmarks. Minutes away from Downtown Dubai, The Dubai Mall, and Dubai International Airport, Elite Business Bay residences are perfectly positioned for those who desire connectivity and convenience, alongside the luxury of city living. With easy access to Sheikh Zayed and Al Khail Road, Elite Business Bay ensures that its residents are never far from the heart of the action.

The Elite Business Bay Residence, nestled within this vibrant district, is a testament to modern luxury living. Overlooking the scenic Marasi Dubai on the Dubai Creek, it presents a unique blend of the excitement of city life with the serenity of waterfront living. The Elite Tower Business Bay, a significant part of this development, stands as a beacon of elite living, offering breathtaking views and world-class amenities to its inhabitants. For those looking to immerse themselves in the lifestyle that Elite Business Bay offers, the Elite Business Bay Residence photos provide a glimpse into the level of sophistication and comfort that awaits.
